item.title: Back to the '90s: I turned my Frankenstein’s monster of a gaming PC into a retro beige beauty in honor of a time when computers used to be fun
item.description: I’m sick of the current state of technology, so I’m turning my gaming rig into a retro PC (and giving Windows 11 a Windows 95 makeover) so I can pretend computing is fun again.

item.title: Inside the London hacker house taking a stand against founder burnout

item.title: Ukraine will mass-produce Stone Cloak EW tech after the UK allows Kyiv to build a tablet-sized device
item.description: Ukraine receives Stone Cloak technology rights from Britain, allowing domestic production of tablet-sized electronic warfare devices designed against enemy drones.

item.title: I replaced Ford BlueCruise with an open-source driver-assistance system — after 1,000 miles, I'm not going back
item.description: After nearly 1,000 miles with Comma 4 in a Ford F-150 Lightning, I found an open-source driver-assistance system that made me skip Ford's $500-a-year BlueCruise subscription.

item.title: Judge denies xAI’s request to block Minnesota ban on ‘nudify’ apps
item.description: Despite a lawsuit from xAI, a Minnesota ban on apps that allow users to “nudify” images can move forward.
